content:
*A short iron wand shaped of interlocking segments leaks greasy black oil from its joints.*

**Keywords:** Psionic

**[Item Prerequisite](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.downtime/item-prerequisite):** A shard of prismacore, an ounce of ferrous metal

**[Project Source](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.downtime/project-source):** Texts or lore in Zaliac

**[Project Roll](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.downtime/project-roll) [Characteristic](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/characteristic):** [Reason](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/reason) or [Intuition](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/intuition)

**Project Goal:** 90

**Effect:** As a maneuver, you snap this wand in half, letting you vertically [pull](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/forced-movement) one object or creature of [size](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/size) 3 or less a number of squares based on that target's [size](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/size):

- **[Size](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/size) 1L or smaller:** vertical [pull](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/forced-movement) 6
- **[Size](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/size) 2:** vertical [pull](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/forced-movement) 3
- **[Size](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/size) 3:** vertical [pull](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/forced-movement) 1

If you [pull](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/forced-movement) a [size](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/size) 1T object [adjacent](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/adjacent) to you, you can catch it. This treasure can affect any target within [line of effect](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/line-of-effect).
